Package com.amibar.boggle.data

Class FirebaseHandler

java.lang.Object
com.amibar.boggle.data.FirebaseHandler
public class FirebaseHandler extends Object
Singleton class that centralizes Firebase Authentication and Realtime Database logic. This simplifies Firebase access across various fragments and activities in the app.
